name: Flock of the Feather Walkers / opponent-response-before-quicken-created
notes: The attack trigger must offer a real response window. Before it resolves, opponent casts Sigil blue and heals20->21; Quicken remains absent while Sigil resolves above the trigger. Only afterward is one Quicken created. The already-played Flock has no go again; it deals5, leaving life16 and AP0. This pilot distinguishes eager token creation from the required triggered-layer behavior. Before the reveal answer, CR5.1.7 asset payment is already complete: resources0, AP0. The reveal effect-cost is paid afterward under CR5.1.8-9.
